measurement_method.operation_runtime: In-process repeated runtime harness (`archive_profile_001_operation_runtime_sections_reports_p50_p95`) measuring export/validate/import wall time inside server paths
measurement_method.hot_sections: In-process repeated section timing for manifest load + signature, archive data load, digest check, timeline validation, and import apply
measurement_method.memory_gate: Process peak working set sampling for the runtime harness cargo command

optimization_slice.change: `load_archive_from_ref` now computes checkpoint/digest summaries only for describe flows; validate/import skip replay + digest-set reconstruction that was not consumed
optimization_slice.expected_effect: Lower runtime latency on validate/import paths by removing redundant per-call summary reconstruction

notes: Run-02 uses runtime-aligned in-process profiling and is directly tied to operation path latency; run-01 values included cargo process overhead.
Manifest load/signature and import apply are the dominant hot sections in run-02 and remain the next optimization candidates if tighter gates are introduced.
